One month before the God of Harvest's descent, wheat growth halted completely. Small-scale withering occurred during the divine blessing. My preliminary conclusion is that as the god's corruption deepens, wheat suffers increasingly. Alternative edible crops must be found quickly.
...
Compared to other crops, <style="highlight">bitter corn</style> is less affected.
Reason: The God of Harvest governs farming; wild plants are less influenced.
Inference: If the God of Harvest falls completely, wheat may wither extensively, while improved wild crops could survive, sustaining humanity.
Improvement Plan: Selective breeding, keeping wild plants with favorable traits. High yield, full grains, drought resistance, pest resistance, good cob texture, short growth cycle...
...
Progress: Growth cycle and yield selection complete.
Next steps...
document:3:366:0.source_cn:
丰饶神神降一月前，小麦生长完全停滞。神降期间，小麦持续出现小范围枯萎。初步推断，随着神堕加深，小麦所受负面影响也将逐步深化。必须尽快寻找其他可食用作物。
……
神降期间，和其他作物相比，<style="highlight">苦苞穗</style>受影响较小。
初步推测原因：丰饶神执掌农耕，对野生植物的影响远小于农作物。
推论：如果丰饶神彻底神堕，呼临境内小麦大量枯萎，改良的野生作物受影响或许较小，能够帮助失去粮食的人类存活。
改良方向：可尝试人工选育，保留具有类农作物优良性状的个体持续选育。选育方向：产量多、籽粒饱满、耐旱、抗虫害、谷穗口感好、生长周期短等……
……
改良进度：生长周期、产量选育已完成。
下一步选育方向……
